title: Data Pipeline with Prefect
summary: A Prefect-based data pipeline project for orchestrating ETL and data workflows using Jupyter notebooks and Python scripts, including synthetic real-estate/property data generation. It fits and saves an SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, driven by SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic tabular data within the pipeline.
evidence: src/generic_data.py:4-5 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata; notebook fits and saves the synthesizer (Testing.ipynb:673)
